title: From Prompting to Behavioral Alignment: Personalized LLM Judges for Recommendation Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.11493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traditional offline recommendation evaluation relies heavily on complex, manually maintained feature pipelines that are difficult to scale. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising alternative by predicting user engagement directly from raw text logs, empirical analysis in this study identifies a critical failure mode termed bidirectional rationalization. In a zero-shot setting, LLMs are found to convincingly argue for both positive and negative user engagement outcomes on the exact same item with identical evidence, highlighting the unreliability of off-the-shelf LLMs in predicting user engagement. To resolve this, we develop and apply a sequential behavioral alignment framework pairing fine-tuning with preference optimization over paired correct and counterfactual rationales. Evaluated on real-world homepage interaction logs, this aligned reasoning approach achieves a 32.19\% lift in Macro-F1 score over the zero-shot baseli

translated_title: 从提示到行为对齐：用于推荐评估的个性化LLM评判器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11493v1 公告类型：新 摘要：传统离线推荐评估严重依赖于复杂且手动维护的特征管道，这些管道难以扩展。虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）通过直接从原始文本日志预测用户参与度提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但本研究的实证分析识别出一个关键失败模式，称为双向合理化。在零样本设置下，发现LLMs能够基于相同证据对完全相同的物品令人信服地论证正面和负面的用户参与结果，这突显了现成LLMs在预测用户参与度方面的不可靠性。为解决此问题，我们开发并应用了一种序列行为对齐框架，将微调与基于配对正确和反事实推理的偏好优化相结合。在真实世界首页交互日志上评估，这种对齐推理方法在Macro-F1分数上比零样本基线提升了32.19%。
tldr: 本研究提出一种序列行为对齐框架，通过微调和偏好优化解决LLM在推荐评估中的双向合理化问题，在真实数据上实现32.19%的Macro-F1提升。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a sequential behavioral alignment framework that combines fine-tuning with preference optimization to address bidirectional rationalization in LLM-based recommendation evaluation, achieving a 32.19% Macro-F1 improvement over zero-shot baselines.
